findings.title: Fallback locales are loaded only for controller requests
findings.body: This is the only call that ensures the fallback locale files are loaded, but translations are also looked up outside controller requests—for example in mailers and background jobs. The translation accelerator loads only the requested locale on its own, so a missing key in those contexts cannot be found in the site-default or English files and falls through as a missing translation.

findings.title: Changing the site locale can leave cached fallback translations stale
findings.body: The fallback chain depends on the mutable `SiteSetting.default_locale`, but the translation cache is keyed only by translation key and current locale. After the site default locale changes, cached translations that came from the old fallback locale can continue to be returned until evicted or the cache is reset, so users may see translations from the previous setting.
